text:
Marco (Support): quick escalation 0m ago: Crescent trial tenant crescent-qa-48 failing activation. High 502/429 on provisioning and embeddings endpoints, rate limiter spikes. Customers can't finish onboarding. Escalating to CS for comms + priority unblock.
Aisha (CS Lead): Received. Thanks Marco. Any ETA from infra? Can we offer a temporary unblock so they don't churn during trial?
Marco (Support): We attempted a key rotation and retry logic but it's a surface-level mitigation. Kofi pulled logs and says a backend job queue backed up. Tagging infra.
Kofi (Infra): Confirmed queue backlog on provisioner. Working on clearing jobs, estimate ~30-45m. Can implement traffic reroute to fallback pool to allow activations at reduced capacity.
Priya (CSM): Need to send a proactive customer update. They are in a high-consideration stage (low-touch flagged to mid-touch) 1-2 seat expansion signal. Recommend call within the hour and offer credit if activation delayed.
Devon (Solutions Eng): Reroute command (internal):
```sh
curl -X POST https://internal.redwood.local/api/v1/reroute \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ADMIN_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{"tenant":"crescent-qa-48","target_pool":"fallback-provision","expires_in":14400}'
```
Marco (Support): I can run that once we get sign-off from Aisha. Will log the change and monitor.
Aisha (CS Lead): Sign-off: proceed with reroute. Priya, draft an initial customer note: short apology, what we're doing (fallback routing + ETA), meeting invite option, and that we'll follow up with postmortem & credits if needed. Keep timeline: 15m ack, 45m call, next update 3h.
Priya (CSM): Draft ready. Posting to #private-dm to keep record. Will send 15m ack now.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2025-1874 (P2) 1: link to runbook: internal/playbooks/provisioning-backlog.md
Marco (Support): Executing reroute now. Will confirm when applied.
Kofi (Infra): Applying expiry on reroute to 4h as stopgap. Will watch for side-effects (KV pressure).
Marco (Support): Reroute applied 0s ago. API returns 200. Monitoring: error rate dropping.
Devon (Solutions Eng): Metrics look better. Provision success rate improving but at lower throughput. Im watching queue drain.
Priya (CSM): Invite sent for 40m from now with SE + Support. Customer replied 0: "Thanks, appreciate the update."
